name: Trödelmarkt am IKEA Köln-Butzweilerhof
facts: a wide range of second-hand and new goods
right at the Köln-Nord motorway junction
paid parking in the IKEA car park and on surrounding car parks
notes: Three dates in the window (11 Oct, 8 Nov, 13 Dec); nothing for January 2027 yet. 'Eintritt frei' is from the site-wide Melan header, hence fee 0. Organiser writes 'S-Bahn: 5'; recorded as 'line 5'. Coordinates from Nominatim for Butzweilerstraße 51 (the IKEA store).

description.de: Etwa einmal im Monat von 11 bis 18 Uhr beim IKEA am Butzweilerhof, direkt am Autobahnkreuz Köln-Nord. Es gibt Trödel und Neuware in großer Auswahl und viele Essensstände. Erreichbar mit der Linie 5 und dem Bus 139; der Eintritt ist frei.
description.en: About once a month from 11 to 6 at the IKEA by Butzweilerhof, right at the Köln-Nord motorway junction. A wide mix of second-hand and new goods, with plenty of food stalls. Line 5 and bus 139 get you there, and entry is free.
